description: What the pundits predicted for one NFL game, counted the way its page on missedtakes.co counts it: how many took each side (one voice per pundit, their latest call standing), the median predicted margin, each pundit's latest score call as a home-minus-away margin, and the final score once the game is played. Identify the game by season year, week (1-18 regular season, 19-22 playoffs) and either team's slug.

teamSlug.description: Either team's slug, e.g. "lions" (find_entities, kind team).

week.description: Week 1-18 for the regular season, 19-22 for the playoffs.

name: game_room
title: Predictions for one NFL game
